move.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX - offer 70240-0
move.body:
Dear Ms Prochazkova,

Thank you for offer 70240-0 at EUR 31.50/unit. Two points must be resolved before we can commit.

Lead time: 52 days exceeds the 35 days our production needs (part:320070). Your standard is 42 days (sup:70240); please confirm 42 days as the maximum.

Payment and price: 45 days net is workable. To move forward we propose EUR 29.00/unit with 30 days net. A domestic supplier quotes a 28-day lead time (sup:70210); we need your best figure to stay in the running.

Please confirm the attached package, or send a counter with a short cost breakdown and your earliest possible lead time.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.subject: Counter-offer pump shaft HX (part:320070) - price and lead time
move.body:

Thank you for offer:70240-1. Your standard lead time of 42 days (sup:70240) meets our production requirement of 35 days (part:320070), so lead time is not the obstacle - the price is.

Your last two packages both hold EUR 31.50 per unit whether at 30 or 45 days net. We need real movement on unit price. In return we confirm 4200 pc per year over 24 months and can accept your standard 42-day lead time.

We propose EUR 29.50/unit at 60 days net with a 35-day lead time, or EUR 30.00/unit at 45 days net with 42 days.

Please confirm one of these, or send your best price and earliest lead time.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
